sections.name: Quick Wins (COA 1 + 2)
sections.accent: The Microsoft + Claude bolt-ons that pay off immediately. Billed at $100/hr.

sections.name: Foundation
sections.accent: The place ĒSO lives. One login. One interface.

sections.name: BD / CRM / Lead Pipeline
sections.accent: Maggie’s pipeline + referrals stop dying in inboxes.

sections.name: Project Management
sections.accent: The system of record bends to ĒSO. Monograph retires.

sections.name: Proposals + Contracts
sections.accent: Hours of writing-from-scratch → minutes of editing.

sections.name: Financial + Billing
sections.accent: Money tracking that doesn’t depend on people remembering.

sections.name: Reporting + Visibility
sections.accent: Reports tell the truth because the system, not humans, generated them.

sections.name: Knowledge + RAG
sections.accent: Firm knowledge becomes searchable in plain English.

sections.name: Communications + Comm Log
sections.accent: What was said to whom, when, lives in one searchable place.

sections.name: Client-Facing Portal
sections.accent: Differentiator. Clients feel taken care of without taking Maggie’s time.

sections.name: Design-Tool Reach
sections.accent: AI starts seeing into Archicad + Bluebeam, not just around them.

sections.name: Voice-First Capture
sections.accent: Friction goes to zero. The capture mechanism Maggie + Moshe already prefer becomes first-class.

sections.name: Brand + Templates
sections.accent: Every artifact looks like ĒSO. Every time.

sections.name: Adoption + Training
sections.accent: Pontis sticks because the team knows how to use it.

sections.name: Community / Industry
sections.accent: Pontis becomes a revenue line for ĒSO, not just a cost center.

modules.name: Confirm M365 Copilot cancellation
modules.description: Carli + Chris already cancelled per May 12 confirmation. FSC verifies no orphan license, no downstream Power Automate flow dependencies.
modules.desiredOutcome: ĒSO stops paying for Copilot. Chris's refund work pays off.

modules.name: Teams + Planner reintegration — advisory
modules.description: Carli leads the internal migration back to project channels + Planner. FSC consults on notification setup so it sticks this time.
modules.desiredOutcome: Project conversations stop hiding in 1:1 DMs. The team can find what was said about a project without DMing three people.

modules.name: Claude Cowork rollout for ĒSO team
modules.description: Provision Cowork accounts; M365 admin consent walkthrough with Chris; desktop install verification for Maggie + Carli (and anyone Maggie names). $20 Pro tier privacy opt-out confirmed.
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie's team has the same AI surface she's been using. Day 1 ready.

modules.name: "How to use Claude" training session #1
modules.description: Live 1.5–2 hour session. Steve runs it; Jon co-pilots. Walks Cowork workflows, native MCP usage, project setup in claude.ai, prompt patterns. Maggie + Carli + others as desired.
modules.desiredOutcome: The team stops being intimidated by AI and starts experimenting. "How do I do X?" answered live, with their own data.

modules.name: Native Claude × M365 connector configuration
modules.description: Configure M365 MCP inside Cowork (Outlook, Word, Teams, SharePoint, OneNote, Lists). Verify each connector returns expected results. Hand off a cheat-sheet for which queries work natively.
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie can ask Claude "summarize my inbox" or "what's on my calendar this week" and get a real answer without leaving the Cowork surface.

modules.name: Claude Cowork power-user follow-up session #2
modules.description: Two-week-later check-in. Review actual usage patterns, troubleshoot what isn't sticking, advance prompt patterns + project structure. Could pull in Rachel or Moshe if their interest develops.
modules.desiredOutcome: The team's Claude habit deepens past the basics. Patterns that didn't stick get redesigned; patterns that did stick get pushed further.

modules.name: Pontis platform foundation (Cosmos-derived)
modules.description: Hosting + auth + data model + web shell. The substrate every other Pontis module hangs off of. First MVP demo to Maggie and Carli within 2–4 weeks.
modules.currentTool: Patchwork of Monograph + HubSpot + shadow Excel + Word
modules.desiredOutcome: The single place ĒSO lives. One login. One interface. One source of truth.

modules.name: Pontis Dashboard — Maggie Home + Carli Home
modules.description: Per-role customizable widget dashboard. Carli's May 4 ask verbatim. Maggie sees pipeline health, fee burn, what's stuck, what's overdue. Carli sees ops queue, AR, staffing capacity, comm log unreads.
modules.currentTool: Maggie pinging Carli 5x/morning for status
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie opens Pontis in the morning and sees the firm. No more pinging Carli with the same five questions every day.

modules.name: Pontis Mobile companion (iOS Shortcut wiring)
modules.description: iOS Shortcuts for voice capture, photo capture, quick-add lead, quick-log time. Maggie's phone becomes a Pontis input device without leaving her existing motion.
modules.currentTool: Notes app voice memos that disappear
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie thinks of something on a site walk, holds the home button, and it's logged. Friction goes to zero.

modules.name: Pontis Admin (users, permissions, integrations, audit)
modules.description: Settings UI. Per-user role + capability mapping. Connected-integration manager (M365, QBO, Bill.com, Twilio, Bluebeam Studio, Claude API, etc.). Audit log for compliance + adoption telemetry.
modules.currentTool: Ad-hoc account creation across 12 tools
modules.desiredOutcome: Carli (and only Carli) can add a new associate to the firm and have them productive Day 1. Nothing rogue gets connected.

modules.name: Pontis ↔ Claude integration layer
modules.description: Pontis exposes its data model to Claude via MCP. Claude reads project state, fee plans, comm log, knowledge repo. Pontis surfaces Claude tool calls directly inside its UI ("ask about this project").
modules.currentTool: Claude not knowing ĒSO's actual data
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie talks to Claude about ĒSO's actual data, not an abstract version. The conversational surface and the system of record stop being separate.

modules.name: Pontis Lead Tracker module
modules.description: Migrates Maggie's claude.ai HTML prototype verbatim into Pontis. 7 statuses, 8 sources, follow-up dates, free-text notes. CSV export from prototype is the seed data.
modules.currentTool: HubSpot ($160/yr, behaviorally dead) + Maggie's browser localStorage prototype
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie's pipeline lives in Pontis, not in her browser's localStorage. Carli can see it too. Survives a closed tab.

modules.name: Pontis Referral Network module
modules.description: Companion to Lead Tracker. 4 tiers (Champion / Active / Warm / Cold), origin story, next-nurture date+action, touchpoint log. Maggie's relationship intelligence externalized from her head.
modules.currentTool: HubSpot + Maggie's head (the relationships)
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops losing referrers. The thank-you note happens. The check-in 90 days later happens. The network grows.

modules.name: Voice flow: referral capture (Flow C)
modules.description: 30-second voice memo → Pontis Lead with referrer + project_type + vibe populated → thank-you email queued for Maggie's review.
modules.currentTool: Referrals lost to memory
modules.desiredOutcome: A referral never disappears. Maggie says "new lead from Daniel — ADU in Tarrytown" walking out of lunch and it's logged.

modules.name: RFP / RFQ source watcher + auto-classifier
modules.description: Monitors the inbound RFP/RFQ channels that matter to ĒSO (residential-majority — NOT SAM.gov per Steve's correction). Auto-classifies into Lead Tracker. Daily "what's open" digest.
modules.currentTool: Maggie skimming RFPs in inbox
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops missing RFPs. The ones that show up are pre-sorted so she only sees the ones worth chasing.

modules.name: Lead-source discovery session + analysis
modules.description: 60-minute working session with Maggie on her last 20 closed deals. FSC builds the data model behind C3-B4. Output: lead-source distribution + conversion patterns + time-to-close.
modules.currentTool: No data on where ĒSO's leads actually come from
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie sees where her business actually comes from. She invests her BD time where the dollars actually land.

modules.name: AI-drafted prospect outreach + follow-up sequences
modules.description: Pontis drafts personalized first-touch emails for inbound leads. Drafts "haven't heard from you in 30 days" follow-up. Maggie reviews before send — never auto-send.
modules.currentTool: Maggie writing first-touch emails from scratch
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops being the bottleneck on first-touch and on staying in touch. The drafts come to her; she edits and sends.

modules.name: Pontis Project module
modules.description: Replaces Monograph project. Project lifecycle modeled as 6-phase (Inquiry → Proposal → Design+Docs+Permitting → CA → Closeout → Cross-cutting). Pace as a first-class concept per Maggie May 4.
modules.currentTool: Monograph (~$4,300/yr) — replaces as system of record
modules.desiredOutcome: The system of record bends to ĒSO's actual project shape. No more workarounds. Pace lives in the system.

modules.name: Resource allocation + staffing module
modules.description: Per-project, per-phase, per-week staffing in hours. Carli's daily Monday-meeting work moves into Pontis. Auto-detects overcommitted associates.
modules.currentTool: Carli's Monday-staffing-meeting spreadsheet
modules.desiredOutcome: Monday staffing is half-done before the meeting starts. Carli stops chasing utilization numbers in spreadsheets.

modules.name: Pace tracker (Maggie's first-class concept)
modules.description: Per-project pace state (sprint / maintenance / hold / dormant) with explicit transitions. Pace decisions flow into resource allocation automatically.
modules.currentTool: Verbal pace decisions that don't make it to the system
modules.desiredOutcome: When Maggie says "we're holding on Wintercreeper for 3 weeks then hitting it hard," the firm acts accordingly without Carli translating.

modules.name: Project task visibility + delegation tracking
modules.description: Maggie's #1 named pain. Pontis surfaces what's been delegated, what's stuck, what's overdue — without requiring Maggie to remember.
modules.currentTool: Maggie's head (delegation tracking — her #1 pain)
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops being the only system that remembers what she asked someone to do. The system remembers.

modules.name: Burn-rate calculator module
modules.description: Per-project, per-phase burn-rate tool that pulls from time tracking + fee plan. Surfaces overrun alerts on Maggie's phone before they compound.
modules.currentTool: Maggie's gut + Monograph fee burn (lagging indicator)
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie knows a project is going sideways at week 4, not at the closeout review. She has time to course-correct.

modules.name: Site-visit follow-up tear-line (Flow A)
modules.description: Voice memo after a site walk → structured tear-line packet → review-and-send via Twilio.
modules.currentTool: Site-visit follow-ups that get sent days late
modules.desiredOutcome: The site-visit follow-up gets sent the same day, not three days later. Clients feel taken care of.

modules.name: Closeout tear-line packet (Flow B)
modules.description: 5-minute closeout dictation → structured packet (final scope, change orders, lessons-learned, fee actuals) → client-ready PDF.
modules.currentTool: Closeout — Maggie's bleed point
modules.desiredOutcome: The closeout bleed point Maggie named gets dressed. Projects close on a defined date. The housewarming gift ritual stays human; the paperwork goes Pontis.

modules.name: RFI tracking module
modules.description: Pontis captures RFIs per project, per phase. Voice-driven entry (Moshe says "flag an RFI on Weber about the foundation detail"). Twilio routes to consultant.
modules.currentTool: RFIs in Moshe's notebook / Bluebeam markups
modules.desiredOutcome: RFIs stop dying in a notebook on Moshe's desk. Open RFIs surface on the project status page.

modules.name: Submittal tracking module
modules.description: Companion to RFI. Submittal log, review status, approval workflow. Pulls from comm log to track who has what version when.
modules.currentTool: Slack-message hunts for submittal versions
modules.desiredOutcome: Construction admin stops being a Slack-message hunt for which version of the door schedule the GC last saw.

modules.name: Daily project rollup digest
modules.description: Per-day Pontis email to Maggie at 7am: what shipped yesterday, what's stuck, what's at risk, what needs her decision today.
modules.currentTool: Maggie's morning status-text-Carli pattern
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie starts the day knowing what to focus on, without reading 15 status updates.

modules.name: Programming Brief generator
modules.description: From a filled New Client Questionnaire + voice memo → Pontis renders a structured Programming Brief. Primed with the ĒSO Client Handbook for voice/tone fidelity.
modules.currentTool: Maggie writing Programming Brief from scratch
modules.desiredOutcome: The programming brief that took Maggie 3 hours of writing takes 30 minutes of editing. The voice still sounds like ĒSO.

modules.name: AI-drafted proposal narrative
modules.description: Pulls Programming Brief + Fee Comparable + Client Handbook → drafts proposal narrative. Maggie edits and sends.
modules.currentTool: Search-and-replace across old proposals
modules.desiredOutcome: Proposals stop being a search-and-replace exercise across old proposals. The first draft is good enough to edit, not rewrite.

modules.name: Six canonical contract templates — Pontis rendered
modules.description: ESO_Exhibit A, New Client Questionnaire, Early Phase Services (Commercial + Residential), Full-Scope Services, Programming Brief — all rendered from Pontis with Brand-Guide token inheritance.
modules.currentTool: Manual Word search-and-replace across 6 templates
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie sends a contract in 5 minutes that took an hour. The legal entity, signatures, and brand are right every time.

modules.name: Fee Comparable history module
modules.description: Every closed project produces normalized $/sf and per-phase fee % records. One-screen lookup filterable by program type / size / jurisdiction.
modules.currentTool: Maggie scrolling Monograph for past fee comparable
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops scrolling Monograph for hours to find the last project like this one. The number she needs is one click away.

modules.name: Auto-fee suggestion engine
modules.description: Project program type + construction value + jurisdiction → Pontis suggests fee using the Fee Comparable history.
modules.currentTool: Maggie pricing at 11pm from memory
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie's fee proposal is calibrated against the firm's actual data, not her gut at 11pm.

modules.name: Feasibility-study automation (resellable to other architects)
modules.description: Every project starts with a feasibility study; every architect does it from scratch. Pontis module: site + code + jurisdiction inputs → preliminary feasibility output. Maggie flagged this as a resellable product to the broader A&E community.
modules.currentTool: 4-hour-per-project feasibility study from scratch (RESELLABLE)
modules.desiredOutcome: The 4-hour feasibility study takes 30 minutes. Other architects pay ĒSO/Pontis for this module — new revenue line.

modules.name: Voice flow: program brief / proposal kickoff (Flow D)
modules.description: Site-walk dictation → structured Program Brief with photos + transcript attached. Primed with the ĒSO Client Handbook.
modules.currentTool: Site-walk thinking lost between car and keyboard
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie does her best thinking on a site walk and it goes into Pontis without her sitting down at a computer.

modules.name: AI-drafted thank-you-and-referral-request email after closeout
modules.description: Every closed project triggers a personalized thank-you draft and a soft referral request. Maggie reviews before send.
modules.currentTool: Maggie not getting to thank-you / referral-request emails
modules.desiredOutcome: The relationship-building work that Maggie wants to do but never has time for, happens. Without nagging her.

modules.name: Pontis Time Tracking module
modules.description: Per-project, per-phase time logging. Voice-first entry ("Pontis, log 2 hours to Weber CD"). Auto-prompts at end of day if nothing logged.
modules.currentTool: Monograph time tracking (replaced)
modules.desiredOutcome: Time logging stops being the thing nobody does. The data behind every report becomes real.

modules.name: Pontis Invoice module
modules.description: Invoice generation from time + fee plan. Auto-reminders at +0, +10, +20, +30, +60 days (Carli's identified gap in Monograph).
modules.currentTool: Monograph invoicing — gap after +10 days
modules.desiredOutcome: Invoices send themselves. Overdue invoices nag themselves. Carli stops being a collections agency.

modules.name: QuickBooks Online sync (replaces Monograph QBO sync)
modules.description: Bidirectional sync: invoices flow to QBO, payments flow back to Pontis. Project P&L stays current.
modules.currentTool: Monograph QBO sync (replaced)
modules.desiredOutcome: The accounting and the project tracking stop disagreeing with each other. Closing the books is faster.

modules.name: Bill.com integration (Carli's AP queue)
modules.description: Carli's accounts-payable queue queryable from Pontis. Voice query: "What bills are due this week?" Surfaces approval queue.
modules.currentTool: Carli swivel-chairing between Bill.com + Pontis + QBO
modules.desiredOutcome: Carli stops jumping between Bill.com, Pontis, and QBO. One place to see what's owed and what's due.

modules.name: Per-phase fee planning + project P&L
modules.description: Fees broken down by phase; actuals tracked against plan. Project P&L visible to Maggie at any time.
modules.currentTool: Maggie not knowing project P&L until closeout
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie knows which projects are making money, which are bleeding, and why.

modules.name: Overrun alerts (push notifications)
modules.description: Real-time alerts when a project trends over its fee plan. Pushes to Maggie's phone, not buried in a weekly report.
modules.currentTool: Overruns caught at closeout, not in week 4
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie catches an overrun at week 3, not at closeout. She has time to have the conversation, not just absorb the cost.

modules.name: End-of-week report generator (per role)
modules.description: Per-employee end-of-week wrap-up. Plugs into time tracking, project state, blockers, decisions needed. Feeds Maggie's Monday meeting prep.
modules.currentTool: Verbal end-of-week updates that consume Monday's first hour
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie's Monday meeting prep is half-done before Monday. Her team's status is captured in 5 minutes per person.

modules.name: Monday morning executive rollup for Maggie
modules.description: Aggregates the end-of-week reports into the question Maggie actually has: what got done, what's stuck, what needs her this week, what's billable.
modules.currentTool: Maggie's morning status-text-Carli pattern
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie walks into Monday knowing what to focus on. The first hour of her week isn't catch-up; it's decision-making.

modules.name: Auto-generated reports (Carli's "no untruth" ask)
modules.description: Reports generate from system state, not from people typing summaries. Carli's May 4 verbatim ask: "force people to use the software, have results inform reports."
modules.currentTool: Manually-typed weekly reports (Carli's 'untruth' problem)
modules.desiredOutcome: The reports Maggie reads are true. Nobody is shading the numbers to make their week look better.

modules.name: Custom widget dashboard builder
modules.description: Carli's May 4 ask: "Maggie a dashboard she could customize that has this stuff in a little widget format." Drag-and-drop, per-user, per-role.
modules.currentTool: No customizable dashboard (Carli's May 4 ask)
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie sees what Maggie wants to see. Carli sees what Carli wants. Nobody scrolls past noise.

modules.name: Voice-queryable business snapshot
modules.description: Maggie's #1 ask. "How are we doing this quarter?" "What's the AR over 60 days?" "Where's Wexford?" Voice in, real answers out — from Pontis data.
modules.currentTool: Maggie asking Carli the same 5 questions every day
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie's questions get answered from the system, not from her memory or Carli's recollection.

modules.name: Adoption telemetry layer
modules.description: Records which features get used, by whom, how often. Surfaces in Maggie's morning digest. The ≥70% governance metric.
modules.currentTool: No view into which features are getting used
modules.desiredOutcome: We know what's working and what isn't. Capability that's not getting used gets redesigned or retired — not allowed to drag.

modules.name: Per-client engagement health score
modules.description: Aggregates last touch, payment history, comm sentiment, project state into a per-client "health" indicator. Surfaces clients quietly drifting before they go cold.
modules.currentTool: Clients drifting cold without anyone noticing
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie sees a client cooling before they ghost. She makes the call. Saves the relationship.

modules.name: Vendor / contractor scorecards
modules.description: Aggregates per-vendor data across projects: on-time-rate, change-order frequency, RFI responsiveness, payment terms honored.
modules.currentTool: Building project teams from gut, not data
modules.desiredOutcome: ĒSO knows which GCs and consultants make their lives easier. New project teams get built from data, not from gut.

modules.name: RAG: ĒSO Client Handbook
modules.description: Recently-revised handbook loaded as a Pontis knowledge source. Maggie's team queries in plain English. Generated artifacts use ĒSO's actual language, not generic AI prose.
modules.currentTool: Onboarding by Carli answering the same questions
modules.desiredOutcome: When somebody asks "what's our process on predesign deliverables for residential?" the answer is the actual handbook answer. No more guessing.

modules.name: RAG: ĒSO Employee Handbook
modules.description: Same treatment. Anyone asks "what's our overtime policy" or "what's the onboarding sequence" — Pontis answers.
modules.currentTool: Carli answering policy questions hour by hour
modules.desiredOutcome: Onboarding stops being Carli answering the same questions every hire. New people get answers without bottlenecking on her.

modules.name: RAG: Brand Guide (for AI-generated artifacts)
modules.description: Brand Guide encoded so every Pontis-generated artifact inherits palette, typography, voice. Frozen token file.
modules.currentTool: Brand drift on every artifact (palette, typography)
modules.desiredOutcome: Every PDF, portal page, email draft Pontis renders looks like ĒSO. Maggie stops being the only line of defense against brand drift.

modules.name: RAG: Project history + Lessons-Learned
modules.description: Closed projects feed a searchable lessons-learned corpus. New projects of similar program type surface relevant past lessons inline.
modules.currentTool: Re-making same mistakes; lessons lost between projects
modules.desiredOutcome: ĒSO stops making the same mistake twice. The lessons from Weber inform Garbos.

modules.name: Permitting knowledge base (Silvana's IRC/IVC)
modules.description: Per-jurisdiction permitting reference. IRC, IVC, fees, document templates, common reviewer issues. Voice-queryable.
modules.currentTool: Silvana's bookmarks + memory (bus-factor)
modules.desiredOutcome: Silvana's expertise becomes the firm's expertise. When Silvana takes vacation, permitting doesn't stop. When Silvana moves on, the knowledge stays.

modules.name: Conversational search over comm history
modules.description: "What did we tell Bennett Fahey about the kitchen counter selection?" Pontis answers from the unified comm log.
modules.currentTool: Hunting through email threads for past client conversation
modules.desiredOutcome: Nobody has to remember what they told a client three months ago. Pontis remembers.

modules.name: Industry / market context RAG
modules.description: AIA standards, IBC/IRC updates, regional market data, jurisdictional changes. Stays current via scheduled updates.
modules.currentTool: Industry news monitoring that nobody has time for
modules.desiredOutcome: The firm stays current on its industry without anyone having to read newsletters.

modules.name: Unified comm log (email + SMS + WhatsApp + iMessage)
modules.description: Twilio integration captures inbound + outbound from all channels. Linked to project + contact. One searchable timeline.
modules.currentTool: Fragmented Outlook + iMessage + WhatsApp + phone
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie stops losing track of which client she said what to. The conversation lives where the project lives.

modules.name: Per-project communication timeline
modules.description: Single timeline view per project: every email, text, WhatsApp, voice memo, meeting. Filterable by sender + topic.
modules.currentTool: Email-thread archaeology
modules.desiredOutcome: When a client says "I thought you said..." the answer is one search away.

modules.name: Client conversation summarization
modules.description: Pontis summarizes a client conversation thread on demand. "What's the latest with Garbos?" → 3-sentence summary + open items.
modules.currentTool: Reading 14-email threads before a client meeting
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie walks into a client meeting up to speed in 30 seconds, even if she hasn't read the thread.

modules.name: AI-drafted client status updates
modules.description: Pontis drafts the weekly client status email pulling from project state + comm log + photos. Maggie reviews and sends.
modules.currentTool: Status updates that don't get sent because Maggie's busy
modules.desiredOutcome: Clients hear from ĒSO on a regular cadence without Maggie writing each one from scratch.

modules.name: Auto-detected scope creep (from email keywords)
modules.description: Pontis flags emails that contain scope-creep signals ("could we also...", "while you're at it...", "one more thing"). Maggie sees the flag, decides whether to absorb or charge.
modules.currentTool: Scope creep accidentally absorbed (fixed-fee projects)
modules.desiredOutcome: Scope creep stops accidentally getting absorbed into a fixed-fee project.

modules.name: Pontis Customer Portal — custom domain, ĒSO-branded
modules.description: Client-facing portal at a custom domain. Inherits Brand Guide tokens. Role-scoped views.
modules.currentTool: No client-facing surface; Carli answers status questions ad hoc
modules.desiredOutcome: Clients feel taken care of without Maggie writing each email. ĒSO looks bigger and more put-together than it is.

modules.name: Per-project status page
modules.description: Public-facing per-client page: milestone tracker, latest site photos, drawing version, invoice list, calendar of upcoming.
modules.currentTool: Client 'where are we?' emails
modules.desiredOutcome: Clients stop emailing "where are we on the project?" They look at the portal.

modules.name: Drawing viewer / annotation surface
modules.description: Client-facing drawing review. Clients comment directly on drawings. Comments route to Bluebeam / project record.
modules.currentTool: Client review via 14-email threads
modules.desiredOutcome: Client review happens on the drawing, not in a 14-email thread. Decisions get logged with the drawing version.

modules.name: Invoice + payment iframe (Stripe)
modules.description: Clients pay invoices directly from the portal. Payment confirmation flows back to Pontis automatically.
modules.currentTool: Manual payment reminders, slow AR
modules.desiredOutcome: Clients pay faster. AR shrinks. Carli stops sending payment reminders.

modules.name: Calendar embed (site visits, milestone reviews)
modules.description: Clients book site-visit times from the portal against Maggie / Moshe / Silvana's actual availability.
modules.currentTool: 6-email scheduling threads for site visits
modules.desiredOutcome: Scheduling stops being a 6-email back-and-forth. The client picks a time that's actually open.

modules.name: Pinterest embed for visual sharing
modules.description: Per-project Pinterest board embedded on the portal. Moshe's existing workflow gets first-class.
modules.currentTool: Pinterest sharing that doesn't make it to project record
modules.desiredOutcome: The visual conversation Moshe already has with clients gets captured to the project record.

modules.name: Self-service client document library
modules.description: Clients access signed contracts, change orders, closeout packets without emailing Carli.
modules.currentTool: 'Can you send me the contract again?' 18-months-later emails
modules.desiredOutcome: Clients stop emailing "can you send me the contract again?" 18 months later.

modules.name: AI client-onboarding packet
modules.description: New-client onboarding sequence: New Client Questionnaire → Programming Brief → Welcome packet → first calendar invite. Pontis drafts; Maggie reviews.
modules.currentTool: Inconsistent client onboarding experience
modules.desiredOutcome: Every new client gets the same high-touch onboarding experience, even when ĒSO is busy.

modules.name: Archicad community-MCP spike (Silvana-led)
modules.description: Bounded spike against tapir-archicad-MCP + lgradisar/archicad-mcp. 5 canonical queries against Bennett Fahey CD. Read-only.
modules.currentTool: Archicad data invisible to Claude / Pontis
modules.desiredOutcome: Silvana asks Claude about Archicad data without leaving Pontis. If the spike works, deeper integration follows.

modules.name: Bluebeam Studio API integration
modules.description: Markup audit + session attendee logs queryable from Pontis. Read-only first.
modules.currentTool: Bluebeam markup data invisible outside Bluebeam
modules.desiredOutcome: "Who edited the Wexford set this week?" answered from Pontis, not from Bluebeam.

modules.name: Adobe Acrobat AI for redline summary
modules.description: PDF markup → structured action-item list. Routes to RFI module if needed.
modules.currentTool: Manually retyping redlines into a checklist
modules.desiredOutcome: Moshe's redlines become a checklist automatically, not by him retyping them.

modules.name: Archicad / Twin Motion file-based bridges
modules.description: Scheduled exports of model schedule + PDF sets from Archicad to Pontis. Read from the export.
modules.currentTool: Manual model export when needed
modules.desiredOutcome: Model data flows into Pontis on its own, without anyone exporting by hand.

modules.name: AI-native design surfaces — free-tier pilots
modules.description: ArchSynth (text-to-massing), Maket.ai (text-to-floorplan), Sloyd / Spline, ComfyUI w/ ControlNets, Rayon. Maggie picks which (if any) to keep at the Phase 1 retro.
modules.currentTool: No AI design surface in Maggie's early-phase work
modules.desiredOutcome: Maggie sees what AI design tools can do for ĒSO's early-phase work. She picks the ones that fit; the others fade.

modules.name: Drawing-set auto-curated Pinterest boards
modules.description: Per-project program brief → auto-suggests Pinterest images that match. Moshe edits / approves.
modules.currentTool: Moshe hunting through Pinterest manually
modules.desiredOutcome: Moshe's visual-sharing workflow gets faster. The right images surface, he doesn't hunt.

modules.name: Voice-first capture pipeline (iOS Shortcut → Whisper → Claude → Pontis REST)
modules.description: The foundational pipeline. Once-built, four voice flows reuse it (A site-visit, B closeout, C referral, D program brief).
modules.currentTool: iOS Shortcuts that don't write anywhere structured
modules.desiredOutcome: Voice in, structured data out. The capture mechanism Maggie and Moshe already prefer becomes first-class.

modules.name: M365 + SaaS license posture surface
modules.description: Continuously surfaces what ĒSO pays for, what's actually enabled, what's behaviorally dead, and what AI capability is available at the current tier. Addresses Microsoft's obfuscation (FSC's May trial finding), the recent Copilot cancellation Carli surfaced, the HubSpot retirement, and the upcoming Monograph renewal call. Pulls from M365 admin + QBO subscriptions + Bill.com. One-screen ledger plus monthly delta alerts.
modules.currentTool: Spreadsheet + tribal knowledge + Chris-and-Carli-via-text. HubSpot has been paid-and-unused; Copilot was paid-then-cancelled without Maggie knowing exact timing.
modules.desiredOutcome: I always know what we're paying for, what works, and what should die next month. Microsoft's obfuscation stops being our problem.

modules.name: Cross-team dependency + handoff surfacer
modules.description: Pontis surfaces what each staff member is blocked on or waiting on from another staff member, across all active projects. Replaces Maggie's manual cross-pollination role ("Sana said she needed this, Mosha said he needed this"). Detects dependencies from task assignee + due-date + project-phase relationships; surfaces a daily 'who's blocking whom' rollup before Monday morning.
modules.currentTool: Maggie verbally cross-references everyone's status update in her head, then re-broadcasts on Monday.
modules.desiredOutcome: Stop being the cross-pollinator. The system tells me who's waiting on whom before Monday — i just confirm and unblock.

modules.name: Monday-morning staffing + resource-allocation briefing
modules.description: Auto-composed Monday-AM brief that fuses Friday end-of-week reports (C3-F1) + open RFIs (C3-C8) + pipeline state (C3-B1) + capacity utilization into the staffing decisions Maggie + Carli already make on Monday. Maggie May 12 verbatim: 'on Monday when we're staffing that's sort of already done.'
modules.currentTool: Manual: Carli + Maggie read seven separate Friday emails Sunday night or Monday morning, then redo the staffing math in their heads.
modules.desiredOutcome: Monday-morning staffing isn't a meeting i prepare for — it's a meeting i review. The brief is already there.

modules.name: Feasibility-study automation (jurisdiction-aware, resellable)
modules.description: Pontis module that auto-generates the early-phase feasibility study for a new project: pulls IRC/IVC + setbacks + lot constraints + permitting requirements + likely fees from the Permitting KB (C3-G5), pairs with project-type + construction-value hints from C3-D4, outputs a client-ready feasibility narrative. Maggie May 12: 'That would be like another version like... if we're saying Pontis is the the monograph version and it could be resold to architects.' Distinct from C3-D6 (the Proposal-phase wrapper) — G8 is the Design-phase jurisdictional intelligence underneath. Resellable as its own product to other architects.
modules.currentTool: Manual: every architect on every project hand-reassembles jurisdictional research, then writes the feasibility study from scratch. Silvana absorbs most of it; Maggie does it for the others.
modules.desiredOutcome: Every new project gets a first-pass feasibility study in minutes, not days. And we ship it as its own product to other architects who need it.

modules.name: Permitting fee + document checklist generator
modules.description: Given a project type, jurisdiction, and construction value, generates the per-jurisdiction fee estimate + the document/submittal checklist Silvana would have built manually. Connects to C3-G5 (Permitting KB) for source data; outputs a one-screen checklist that auto-attaches to the project record and updates as the project moves through phases.
modules.currentTool: Silvana looks up codes, hand-computes fees per jurisdiction, types the checklist in OneNote.
modules.desiredOutcome: Silvana doesn't re-look-up the same jurisdiction twice. New permits show me the fee + the checklist on day one.

modules.name: GC / contractor handoff packet (CA phase kickoff)

modules.desiredOutcome: Every GC handoff is the same packet, every time. No more 'did we send them the latest set?' on day one of CA.

modules.name: Post-closeout client survey + NPS feedback loop
